mapper.sql: id, server_name, ip_address, server_type, location, specs, mfa_key, server_status, remote_account, remote_pwd, backend_account, backend_pwd, remark, create_time, expire_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_server ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_server
AND server_status = #{serverStatus}
